quests.title: New Idea

dialogue.t: Hello, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Thanks to your help, I've finished making adjustments to the robots you found previously.
So far, I haven't run into any new problems, but what I have run into is a new idea...
When you track down the other robots, {NICKNAME}, can you pay attention to any of their special behaviors?
Well, that'd be... how they interact with each other, I suppose? Ah, it should be much more obvious once we've recovered enough of them.
Okay... Well, leave it to us!
Thank you both! I'll mark the next area on your map...

quests.description: Ginette tweaks the recovered robots, and a new possibility blooms for her research…
